court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: District Revenue Officer and Others … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Respondent(s): Mr. C. Jayaprakash, GA (R1 to R 3)
judgment_text:
Writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking for issuance of a writ of mandamus to direct the 1st Respondent to consider the petitioner's appeal dated 27.01.2026.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Abdul Quddhose, J.:— This writ petition has been filed seeking for a limited relief. The petitioner seeks for early disposal of his appeal dated 27.01.2026 pending on the file of the first respondent.

2. Mr. C. Jayaprakash, learned Government Advocate, accepts notice on behalf of the respondents 1 to 3.

3. No prejudice will be caused to the first respondent if the petitioner's appeal dated 27.01.2026 is considered on merits and in accordance with law, after hearing the objections of the respondents 4 and 5, and also by adhering to the principles of natural justice. Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed of by directing the first respondent to dispose of the petitioner's appeal dated 27.01.2026, on merits and in accordance with law, after hearing the objections of the respondents 4 and 5 and any other party whom the first respondent deems it fit to enquire, by adhering to the principles of natural justice, within a period of four months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. This Court is not expressing any opinion on the merits of the petitioner's appeal dated 27.01.2026. No Costs.
